intro: Our published list of MBA colleges accepting JEMAT 2026 currently shows {{published}} colleges, drawn from {{count}} programme cards. They are West Bengal institutes on the official MAKAUT participating list, including campuses in Durgapur, Kolkata, Kalyani, Hooghly, Darjeeling and Haldia.

JEMAT 2026 was conducted by MAKAUT, West Bengal, for MBA admissions in the state. The official portal scheduled the computer-based test on 7 June 2026, with online applications from 10 May to 1 June 2026.
listLead: These cards are the top MBA / PGDM colleges accepting JEMAT 2026 in our published records. Some colleges appear more than once because we hold several MBA specialisations for them.
snapshot: We hold {{colleges}} published colleges on this list, all in West Bengal. The official JEMAT process still covers a wider set of MAKAUT and other state MBA programmes, including some campuses that are not yet published in our file.

Haldia Institute of Technology has a recorded MBA fee of ₹2.401 lakh. BCET's first cards have no recorded fee. A recorded average of ₹3 lakh appears for both in our data, and should be treated as historical.
firstCollegesLead: Some colleges, such as BCET, Durgapur, occupy more than one specialisation row. That is a listing shape issue, not a ranking of one college over the others.
Haldia Institute of Technology is listed under Kolkata in our records. Confirm the official campus location before you plan travel, because the institute is commonly associated with Haldia.

sections.heading: Official JEMAT 2026 admission rules
paragraphs: MAKAUT's official JEMAT pages say the test is a state-level exam for MBA, MHA and some AICTE-approved PG diploma programmes, conducted for the Government of West Bengal.

The 2026 brochure required a 3- or 4-year bachelor's degree in arts, science, commerce, engineering, technology, medical, dental, agriculture or another professional course from a recognised university. Foreign students were not eligible to sit the test.
bullets: Online applications opened on 10 May 2026 and closed on 1 June 2026, as extended on the official portal.
The computer-based test was held on 7 June 2026, with rank cards issued on 20 June 2026 and e-counselling later in July.
MAKAUT notes that colleges may also admit using a national test such as CAT or MAT, and that qualifying JEMAT does not by itself guarantee a seat.

compare.heading: How to shortlist MBA colleges accepting JEMAT 2026

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges accepting JEMAT 2026 are on this list?
faqs.answer: We currently list {{published}} published colleges, from {{count}} programme cards. Officially, JEMAT is used across a wider set of West Bengal MBA programmes, including some campuses that are not yet published in our file.

faqs.question: Who conducted JEMAT 2026, and when was the test?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT, West Bengal, conducted the computer-based JEMAT on 7 June 2026. Applications ran from 10 May to 1 June 2026, as published on the official portal.

faqs.question: What was the eligibility for JEMAT 2026?
faqs.answer: The official 2026 brochure required a 3- or 4-year recognised bachelor's degree in a listed faculty, including professional courses. Final-year students could apply, and foreign students were not eligible to sit the test.

faqs.question: Does a JEMAT rank guarantee admission?
faqs.answer: No. MAKAUT states that mere qualification does not make a candidate eligible for admission to a chosen college. Colleges may also use CAT or MAT, and each has its own criteria.
